description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a RecyclerView adapter for displaying smart home devices, specifically device cards with focus, selection, and toggle support for TV remote control.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying smart home device cards with TV remote support, manages device item views and interactions.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view layout and creates a DeviceViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds device data to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of device items.
